dataset.analysis_timeframe: H1 causal trend state and M15 reaction/first-passage layer derived from M1

hypotheses.market_question: If exact pivot lines are not privileged, does a measurable spatial zone around pivots alter attraction, stall, reversal or trend-terminal hazard?
hypotheses.null: Occupancy-adjusted behavior near pivots is no different from matched spatial controls after predeclared falsification.
hypotheses.alternative: A predeclared pivot-proximity zone shows a monotonic and cross-pair robust effect on at least one mechanism after correction.
hypotheses.mechanism: Pivot relevance, if real, may be spatial rather than point-exact; price can overshoot/undershoot a watched reference before a terminal response.

method.primary_endpoint: S1-S5 primary family at the preregistered 20%-of-adjacent-spacing pivot zone, including occupancy-adjusted terminal-extreme enrichment; secondary 5/10/15/20/25% width curves are descriptive coherence evidence only.
method.economic_effect_size: For promoted S5: percentage-point enrichment in terminal-extreme incidence per H1 occupancy exposure in normalized 0-20% proximity versus 30-50% distance.
method.event_definition: Same New York 17:00 classic-pivot construction as parent. Real zones use symmetric half-widths 5%,10%,15%,20%,25% of applicable adjacent spacing, with 20% primary. Far-control centers are at 50% of adjacent spacing and use equal width. S5 assigns each valid H1 close to nearest pivot, normalizes distance by side-specific adjacent spacing, bins 0-10 through 40-50%, and compares independently confirmed ATR-defined H1 trend-leg terminal extrema per occupancy exposure.
controls: equal-width far midpoint controls centered 50% of adjacent spacing from the pivot

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across 25 primary hypotheses (S1-S5 × five timeframes); secondary width curves cannot promote

holdout.prior_exposure: 2015-2021 pivot target/reversal and spatial-zone development programme; 2022-2025 untouched

provenance.notes: Broad pivot magnet/reversal claim remains rejected; only the narrower daily/weekly terminal-hazard mechanism was promoted.
